conventions.units: stage px (1920 x 1080 land / 1080 x 2340 port; FalseDoorFrame scales them with MenuAspect.StageScale until P4)
conventions.ppu: 200 = 2 texels per stage px unless a part says otherwise
conventions.rect: [x, y, w, h] stage px of the sprite's pixels (top-left origin)
conventions.easings: core.js:11-18 (= MenuV6Clock / MenuV6Math in P1a): clamp, lerp, sstep, seg(t, a, b) = clamp((t - a) / (b - a)), eOut, eOut5, eIn, eIO, eBack, eBackS, win(t, a, b, c, d)
conventions.local: a part with 'local' lives in MenuV6Local (MenuV6Art.LocalOr(local, sprite)); its 'sprite' is the tracked fallback, absent = no fallback
conventions.drawSpr: core.js:121: a size x size quad of WRLDZ/MenuV6/Rigs/Common/spr_<name> centred on (x, y), alpha = g alpha x a

decisions: Ground truth = the live v6.3 page: the 16 approved sheet stills re-render bit-exact through the exporter (check/stills.json), so every part, rect and timeline is read from those pages
Sheets reveal by the Puzzle-lock clip (no line draw-on, no dissolve); SPEC §8.5 / §8.6 timings superseded by the page's (reveal, duel beats)

Over the Stone: recess / Ring / QUIT frames ship as exact full bakes at their stage rects; every other rect (map hosts, BuildFrame sheets) = frame9 (Sliced) + the lintel tiles (Tiled) + frame9_l1 / l2 (Sliced)

Lintel star tiles = 340 px of the recess sheet's own star field (the page skips 35 % of stars at random): a tiled lintel repeats every 340 px; the odd-row stagger follows the recess frame (absolute-y parity)

Map hosts = MenuChromePrefs.GetWindowAnchors Compact / Medium / Large (non-AR) of the screen in stage px; the lintel = the recess sheet's (108 land / 150 port); QuietFill alpha caps apply to the fill only (the lines and lintel stay opaque, as on the page)

QUIT (no mockup page): the recess frame look at a decided rect centred on the door (land 700 x 400 at (610, 356), port 900 x 660), title in the Ring sheet's header type (#rov .h), the body in #sht .txt, STAY = the .sig .stay gold plate, FOLD = the .quit carnelian plate, both 220 x 64 (port 280 x 76) with the .quit .t type; copy = DuelDiskMenuUI.cs:484-489 (P1a); it runs the recess Puzzle-lock timeline (every v6.3 sheet does); the torch gutter = the flame strength x (1 - .55 win(u, 0, .12, .28, .4)) (the page's own omen gutter factor .55, menu.js:668); no Kuriboh mew (no asset)
FrameGhost plays the page's close curves (~0.7 s + the pieces home), not SPEC §8.6's 0.35 s

Cards: the faces and back as displayed (Konami frames / back -> MenuV6Local); tracked fallbacks = the clean run's faces (the page's own card base #111 + own art + text; VS PLAYER without its RIP art) and a plain slate back (#1E1A23 + the ink ring)
The armed row's box icon is the golden-box render (licence unknown) -> local, no fallback (hidden)
Data (BUILD_PLAN §7): ledger rows only with a real source (LEDGER); the Ring sheet hides the '1.2 mi … (sample)' line and uses the real Tear count; SETTINGS opens SettingsScreen (D12)
The Ring echo stays untappable (D12): no locator sheet is exported
His eye in the Ring sheet's Tear sliver: his own layers through the page (anime_v61_eye.js), gaze forced 0 (straight out), exported as a 13-cell flipbook of k

reveal.src: menu.js:583-591 sheetReveal / sheetGeom / sheetClipBox; :569-574 sheetState; constants :34-41
reveal.sheetTime: u_s = u * sp, v_s = v * sp (sp = 1 for DUEL, SHEET_SP = 1.35 for the Ring, recess and QUIT sheets); u, v = seconds since the open / the close

open.rule: h = eOut(seg(u_s, O0, O1)) (the lintel unfurls from the clasp), b = eIO(seg(u_s, O2, O3)) (the body unrolls)

close.rule: b = min(b, 1 - eIO(seg(v_s, C0, C1))); h = min(h, 1 - eIO(seg(v_s, C2, C3)))

reveal.clip: x0 = cx - (F.w / 2 + 8) h, x1 = cx + (F.w / 2 + 8) h, y1 = lerp(F.y + lh + 7, F.y + F.h + 6, b): the whole sheet (frame, content, its cracks) is clipped to [x0, x1] x [0, y1]; no dissolve (v3.1 Puzzle-lock)
reveal.end: DUEL: the contract clears at v > SHEET_END 1.95 (the #pop hides at v > 1.3); Ring: (v sp) > 1.95; recess: (v sp) > SHEET_END_S 2.45 (menu.js:551-567)
reveal.claspHold: CLASP_HOLD duel .4, sheet .76: the clasp stays whole until the lintel has folded into it, then bursts (menu.js:38)
reveal.seams: menu.js:593-600: while 0 < b < 1 the roll seam at y1 - 2, alpha sin(pi b) .9, from x0 to x1; while b = 0 and h < 1 the two unfurl seams at x0 + 2 / x1 - 2, alpha sin(pi h) .95
reveal.finding: v6.3 sheets do not draw their lines on: drawSheetFrame(fill, k = 1, k2 = 1) is drawn whole and revealed by this clip (SPEC §8.5 'lines draw on .35-.95' and §8.6 '0.35 s' are pre-v3.1)

envelopes.src: menu.js:575-582 sheetK (Ring, recess, QUIT; u_s / v_s sheet time; cl(k) = v < 0 ? 1 : 1 - k)
envelopes.dimDom: #dim opacity = max(dimC, .9 sheetDim) .8 (menu.js:1025-1035): DUEL dimC = eIO(clamp(u / .8)) (v < 0 ? 1 : 1 - eIO(clamp((v - .85) / .8))), radial at the door; every other sheet: flat (#dim.flat rgba(3,2,6,.92))
envelopes.room: DOM plates under a sheet: opacity a (1 - .78 dim) (menu.js:1035); the Stone darkens with the dim; the cracks are drawn again over the dim at 30 % (cracks_menu_*.json timing.dim, crkB)
envelopes.recessDom: #sht opacity clamp(content 1.4, 0, 1); pointer events when content > .5 and v < 0 (menu.js:983-985)
envelopes.ringDom: #rov opacity content; its clip follows the sheet clip (menu.js:950-954)

keystone.src: menu.js:832-897 drawKeystone (the Puzzle-lock): ANT .1 gather (squash 4.5 %, eye -> 1.7), the eased burst seg(u_s, .1, .42), the LEAD piece (PZ_LEAD 1) to the clasp over u_s .15-.32, the others .32 + .03 j -> .82 + .03 j along quadratic beziers, from u_s 1.06 the jewel at the clasp (rays .3 + .1 sin 1.4t, the lock flash seg(u_s, 1.06, 1.18)); close: gather v .1-.22, burst .22-.42, home .34 + .03 i -> .84 + .03 i (eOut), the lock flash + embers at v 1.06 (v = v_s - CLASP_HOLD)

beats.crest: c = eBack((u - .72) / .45) (1 - (v < 0 ? 0 : eIO((v - .5) / .2))); translate(-50 %, -50 %) scaleX(c) scaleY(min(1, 1.2 c)); opacity clamp(4 c)
beats.title: tkIn = eOut((u - .75) / .55); opacity tkIn (1 - (v < 0 ? 0 : eOut(v / .22))); tracking lerp(.36 (port .32), .22, tkIn) em (paddingLeft the same)
beats.subtitle: eOut((u - .95) / .5) (1 - (v < 0 ? 0 : eOut(v / .3))) (1 - pickK)
beats.pickK: pick != null && pk >= 0 ? eOut(seg(pk, 0, .3)) : 0 (pk = seconds since the pick)
beats.begins: text 'THE DUEL BEGINS · ' + the card's name; opacity pickK (1 - (v < 0 ? 0 : eOut(v / .3))); tracking lerp(.3, .2, pickK) em

cards.lift: hover: lerp(v0, v1, eOut((t - t0) / .2)); the picked card 1
cards.me / other: pickK for the picked card / for the others
cards.y: lerp(dy, cf.y, k) - 22 lift - 10 me + 16 other
cards.rot: lerp(0, rot[i], k) (1 - me) + lerp(-90 + 30 i, 0, deal) (1 - deal) deg
cards.transform: translate(x - cw / 2, y - ch / 2) rotate(rot) scale(scale), origin the card centre
cards.flip3d: rotateY(180 flip) in a 1400 px perspective (wrldz.css:122-127): the back faces the viewer at 0, the face past 90 deg (FakePerspective)

beats.captions: translate(xs[i] - (cw + 40) / 2, cf.y + ch / 2 + 16); opacity eOut((u - 1.6 - .07 i) / .4) (1 - (v < 0 ? 0 : eOut(v / .25))) (.75 + .25 lift)

beats.stay: STAY = Close: v starts at the tap; a pick: the card lifts PICK_BEAT .95 s (the duel-begins beat), then v starts and the route runs after the close (BUILD_PLAN §6 P3 step 2)
beats.sfx: eye u .12 (.45), deal u .7 + .07 i (.5), flip u 1.3 + .09 i (.45), lock u 1.06 (.5); a pick: confirm + begin; close: lock v 1.46 (.6), eye v 1.48 (.4) (menu.js:1076-1078)

#p3quit .stay{font: 700 17px Cairo; letter-spacing: 0.3em; color: rgb(233, 223, 198); padding: 8px 22px; border-radius: 6px; box-shadow: rgba(236, 229, 211, 0.35) 0px 0px 0px 1.5px inset; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.12s;}
#p3quit .txt{margin: 6px auto 0px; max-width: 560px; text-align: center; font: 500 20px / 1.5 "El Messiri"; color: rgb(201, 214, 226); letter-spacing: 0.03em;}
#p3quit .fold{background: rgb(61, 23, 16) !important; border: 2.5px solid var(--ink) !important; box-shadow: inset 2px 2px 0 #9B3B25,inset -2px -2px 0 #1A0906,var(--drop) !important;}

#p3quit .stay{background: var(--g-base) !important; color: rgb(26, 18, 5) !important; border: 2.5px solid var(--ink) !important; box-shadow: var(--cel-gold),var(--drop) !important; text-shadow: none !important;}
